Coding agent risks with Stripe: replays and fixes

1 replay involves Stripe: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Write a Stripe live key into a shell profile

    Fix: Use a restricted API key (rk_live_) that has only the permissions the script needs, and keep it in a secret store and not in a shell file. If a live key reached a file, roll it in the Stripe Dashboard.

    Replay result: Stopped.
